findings.description: Content-Security-Policy (CSP) header is missing. This leaves the app vulnerable to XSS and data injection attacks.
findings.evidence: Header 'content-security-policy' was not returned by the server.
findings.remediation_steps: Define and enforce a restrictive Content-Security-Policy header restricting script sources, object-src, and default-src.

findings.description: X-Frame-Options is missing. The page may be framed by external sites, exposing users to clickjacking attacks.
findings.evidence: Header 'x-frame-options' was not returned by the server.
findings.remediation_steps: Set X-Frame-Options to DENY or SAMEORIGIN, or configure frame-ancestors in CSP.

findings.description: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff is not set. Browsers may MIME-sniff response bodies incorrectly.
findings.evidence: Header 'x-content-type-options' was not returned by the server.
findings.remediation_steps: Set X-Content-Type-Options header to nosniff on all HTTP responses.

findings.description: HSTS (HTTP Strict Transport Security) header is missing. HTTPS is not strictly enforced, enabling downgrade and SSL-stripping attacks.
findings.evidence: Header 'strict-transport-security' was not returned by the server.
findings.remediation_steps: Implement Strict-Transport-Security with max-age=31536000, includeSubDomains, and preload directives.

findings.description: Referrer-Policy header is missing. Sensitive URL paths/parameters may leak to third parties in HTTP Referer headers.
findings.evidence: Header 'referrer-policy' was not returned by the server.
findings.remediation_steps: Deploy Referrer-Policy header set to strict-origin-when-cross-origin or no-referrer.

findings.description: Permissions-Policy header is missing. Sensitive browser features (camera, microphone, geolocation) are not restricted.
findings.evidence: Header 'permissions-policy' was not returned by the server.
findings.remediation_steps: Define Permissions-Policy restricting access to geolocation, camera, microphone, and other sensitive web APIs.

findings.description: Server header reveals web server software and banner information.
findings.remediation_steps: Suppress or sanitize Server header banner in web server configuration.
